A string's pitch can be calculated.
Dans son Harmonie universelle, Mersenne: In his Harmonie universelle, Mersenne links a string's pitch to its length, its tension and its thickness.
Guido d'Arezzo nomme les notes: Guido of Arezzo names the notes
Ut, ré, mi, fa, sol, la : les notes ont: Ut, re, mi, fa, sol, la: the notes get names.
Dans une lettre au moine Michel de Pompo: In a letter to the monk Michael of Pomposa, Guido is credited with the idea of taking the syllables from the hymn Ut queant laxis, each line of which starts one note higher.
Philolaos et les rapports des sons: Philolaus and the ratios of sounds
Le pythagoricien Philolaos décrit l'octa: The Pythagorean Philolaus describes the octave (2/1) divided into a fifth (3/2) and a fourth (4/3). The accounts that credit Pythagoras himself with the discovery are unreliable.
Glaréan ajoute l'ionien et l'éolien: Glarean adds the Ionian and the Aeolian
Les futurs majeur et mineur entrent dans: The future major and minor enter music theory.
Dans son Dodecachordon, le Suisse Heinri: In his Dodecachordon, the Swiss Heinrich Glarean takes the modes from eight to twelve. The Ionian matches our major scale, the Aeolian the natural minor.
Tout son périodique est une somme de sin: Every periodic sound is a sum of sine waves.
Joseph Fourier publie sa Théorie analyti: Joseph Fourier publishes his Analytical Theory of Heat. The tool, designed for heat, is now used to analyze every recorded sound.
Rameau publie son Traité de l'harmonie: Rameau publishes his Treatise on Harmony
An inverted chord is still the same chord.
Rameau y décrit les renversements et la: Rameau describes inversions and the fundamental bass, which become the grammar of classical harmony.
Douze demi-tons égaux, calculés au chiff: Twelve equal semitones, calculated to the digit.
Le prince chinois Zhu Zaiyu calcule au b: The Chinese prince Zhu Zaiyu computes the twelfth root of 2 on an abacus to 24 exact decimals: twelve perfectly equal semitones.
L'oreille n'entend pas toutes les fréque: The ear does not hear all frequencies alike.
Avec des écouteurs, Harvey Fletcher et W: Using headphones, Harvey Fletcher and Wilden Munson measure how much intensity each frequency needs to seem equally loud.
En Chine, au bord du fleuve Jaune, les v: In China, near the Yellow River, the villagers of Jiahu play flutes carved from crane bones.
Le site est habité d'environ 7000 à 5700: The site was inhabited from about 7000 to 5700 BC; 33 flutes were found there, some of which can still be played.
Près de Tralles, en Turquie, on retrouve: Near Tralles, in Turkey, a gravestone is found bearing the oldest known complete song.
L'archéologue William Ramsay en publie l: The archaeologist William Ramsay published a description the same year. The foot of the stone would soon be sawn off to serve as a stand for flowerpots.
Dans le Hubei, on sort de la tombe du ma: In Hubei, a complete chime of 65 bronze bells is brought out of the tomb of Marquis Yi of Zeng.
Enterrées vers 433 av. J.-C., elles sont: Buried around 433 BC, they are almost intact, cover five octaves and still ring. They are displayed in Wuhan.
À Venise, le traité de musique de Boèce,: In Venice, Boethius's music treatise, nearly a thousand years old, goes to press.
De institutione musica paraît en 1491-14: De institutione musica appeared in 1491-1492, one of the first musical texts printed in Venice. It had circulated in about 140 medieval manuscripts.
Avant 1365, à Reims, Guillaume de Machau: Before 1365, at Reims, Guillaume de Machaut set the whole Mass to music, in four voices.
La Messe de Nostre Dame est la plus anci: The Messe de Nostre Dame is the oldest complete Mass by a single composer: six movements, from the Kyrie to the Ite, missa est.
Un seul passage sous la presse: A single pass through the press
À Paris, Pierre Attaingnant imprime la m: In Paris, Pierre Attaingnant prints music in one go: notes, staves and words together.
Il l'utilise dans ses Chansons nouvelles: He used it in his Chansons nouvelles en musique à quatre parties. The method became the standard in Europe for two centuries.
À Venise, le théâtre San Cassiano ouvre: In Venice, the San Cassiano theatre opens opera to anyone who pays for a seat.
On y donne L'Andromeda de Francesco Mane: Francesco Manelli's L'Andromeda is performed there. Opera is no longer reserved for princes' festivities.
À Londres, une conférence internationale: In London, an international conference recommends tuning A to 440 Hz.
L'ISO adopte cette norme en 1955 et la c: ISO adopted this standard in 1955 and reaffirmed it in 1975. France had fixed A at 435 Hz by a law of 1859.
À Berlin, AEG présente le Magnetophon K1: In Berlin, AEG presents the Magnetophon K1, the first practical tape recorder.
La bande est mise au point chez IG Farbe: The tape was developed at IG Farben and BASF. Cut and spliced, it would allow sound to be edited like film.
À Vienne, un concert d'œuvres de Schoenb: In Vienna, a concert of works by Schoenberg and his pupils turns into a scandal.
C'est le 31 mars 1913. Deux mois plus ta: It was 31 March 1913. Two months later, in Paris, The Rite of Spring caused a scandal in its turn.
À Paris, Pierre Schaeffer présente en co: In Paris, Pierre Schaeffer presents in concert studies made of recorded sounds: musique concrète.
Le 5 octobre 1948, cinq études composées: On 5 October 1948, five studies composed on the phonograph, including one made of train noises. Schaeffer would found the GRM ten years later.
Au Japon, les 50 premiers disques compac: In Japan, the first 50 compact discs go on sale, led by Billy Joel's 52nd Street.
C'est le 1er octobre 1982. Le son y est: It was 1 October 1982. The sound is coded in 16 bits, 44,100 times a second, on two channels.
